_comment: Set VLLM_ENABLED=true to enable vLLM mode; default model is Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-AWQ. Legacy Mistral adapters specific to 7B are removed.

synthesizer.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen_synth_v1 by default.

re_ranker.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen_re_ranker_v1 by default.

fact_checker.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen_fact_checker_v1 by default.

critic.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen_critic_v1 by default.

journalist.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen_journalist_v1 by default.

chief_editor.notes: Uses ModelStore adapters qwen_chief_editor_v1 (editorial decisions) and qwen2_headline_v1 (headline generation).

reasoning.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen_reasoning_v1 by default.

analyst.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen_analyst_v1 by default.

crawler_triage.notes: Uses ModelStore adapter qwen2_crawler_triage_v1 for Crawl4AI ingestion triage classification.

scout.notes: [DEPRECATED] Embeddings-only agent; functionality moved to Investigator

visual_investigator.notes: Used by Investigator agent for multi-modal evidence analysis (Visual Question Answering).
